$comment: Single source of truth for third-party inputs (ADR docs/adr/20261104-supply-chain-provenance.md). Checked by build/deps.ts (./seclab lint deps); renders docs/DEPENDENCIES.md (./seclab docs write).

deps.name: Code-OSS (microsoft/vscode) 1.145.0
deps.purpose: The editor and REH we build and patch.
deps.provenance: Git commit in the project's own repo; tag 1.145.0 resolves to the pinned SHA.
deps.verify: build/fetch-upstream.sh: git ls-remote tag -> SHA must equal upstream.lock, then checkout by SHA (no tarballs).
deps.bump: Fork-build session, manually (AGENTS.md 'Bump upstream'): new tag+SHA in upstream.lock, re-run patches, RPC inventory and its review.

deps.name: Electron, Node.js and built-in extension downloads of the Code-OSS build
deps.purpose: Runtime binaries and the three upstream built-ins the gulp build fetches.
deps.provenance: SHA-256 manifests checked into the pinned source (build/checksums/electron.txt, nodejs.txt); built-in extension sha256 in upstream product.json.
deps.verify: Upstream build/lib/fetch.ts rejects any download whose sha256 differs (validateChecksum for Electron; getNodeChecksum for the REH node).

deps.name: Code-OSS npm dependency tree
deps.publisher: Each package's own npm account (locked by Microsoft's lockfiles)
deps.purpose: Build-time and bundled JS dependencies of the editor.
deps.provenance: Upstream package-lock.json files (sha512 integrity per package) at the pinned SHA.
deps.verify: npm ci (lockfile integrity, fails on mismatch); runs in the builder container or on Actions, never on the host.
deps.gap: Integrity pins bytes but not origin; npm audit signatures over the tree is the next step (registry signatures + provenance where published).

deps.name: node:24.22.1-trixie
deps.purpose: Builder base (Node must equal upstream .nvmrc) and the pinned runner for all repo tooling (docs, lints, unit tests, harness).
deps.provenance: Unsigned BuildKit provenance/SBOM; the image build itself GPG-verifies Node's SHASUMS256 (nodejs/docker-node).
deps.verify: Digest pin; tag/version must match upstream .nvmrc (build/prepare.sh).
deps.bump: Dependabot (docker) for Dockerfiles, scheduled pin check for seclab/TS; majors refused until upstream .nvmrc moves.
deps.gap: Docker Official Images are not signed (Content Trust retired, no Sigstore yet); Docker Hardened Images are signed but paid.

deps.name: python:3.12-slim
deps.purpose: Runner for the stdlib-only RPC filter tools.
deps.provenance: Unsigned BuildKit provenance/SBOM.
deps.verify: Digest pin (multi-arch index); runs with --network none.
deps.bump: RPC filter session; scheduled pin check.
deps.gap: Docker Official Images are not signed.

deps.name: python:3.13-slim-trixie
deps.purpose: Broker integration test harness and upstream images.
deps.provenance: Unsigned BuildKit provenance/SBOM.
deps.verify: Digest pin.
deps.gap: Docker Official Images are not signed.

deps.name: debian:trixie-slim
deps.purpose: OCI tab image base; broker workspace test image.
deps.provenance: Unsigned BuildKit provenance; ships debian-archive-keyring, so apt inside it verifies signatures.
deps.verify: Digest pin.
deps.gap: Docker Official Images are not signed.

deps.name: alpine:3.22
deps.purpose: Broker placeholder base; small utility containers (cache copy, release checks).
deps.provenance: Unsigned BuildKit provenance/SBOM.
deps.verify: Digest pin.
deps.bump: Dependabot (docker) for the Dockerfile; scheduled pin check for the rest.
deps.gap: Docker Official Images are not signed.

deps.name: nginx:alpine
deps.purpose: Test-only HTTP target in the containment harness.
deps.provenance: Unsigned BuildKit provenance/SBOM.
deps.verify: Digest pin; runs on an internal network.
deps.gap: Docker Official Images are not signed.

deps.name: docker:29-cli
deps.purpose: Docker CLI inside the broker integration harness image.
deps.provenance: Unsigned BuildKit provenance/SBOM.
deps.verify: Digest pin.
deps.gap: Docker Official Images are not signed.

deps.name: mitmproxy/mitmproxy:12.3.1
deps.purpose: Broker base image (egress and credential broker).
deps.provenance: GitHub artifact attestation (SLSA v1 provenance, Sigstore), signer mitmproxy/mitmproxy .github/workflows/main.yml@refs/tags/v12.3.1.
deps.verify: Broker session's provenance check (gh attestation verify oci://… pinned to the signer workflow and source commit) before the broker image build; lands with the broker's review record.

deps.name: lycheeverse/lychee 0.24.2
deps.purpose: External link check in docs-check (--online).
deps.provenance: None for this release: the upstream attest job failed for lychee-v0.24.2, and the Docker Hub image is never attested.
deps.verify: Digest pin; read-only repo mount; no credentials (removed 2026-11-04).
deps.gap: No signature available. Proposed: re-pin to a release whose binary attestation verifies and run that binary in our pinned base, or build from the tagged source.

deps.name: rhysd/actionlint:1.7.12
deps.purpose: Workflow static analysis (./seclab lint workflows).
deps.provenance: Image unattested; the release binaries carry a GitHub attestation (release.yaml@refs/tags/v1.7.12).
deps.verify: Digest pin; --network none, read-only mount, no credentials.
deps.gap: Attested binary exists but the image is not attested. Proposed: run the attested release binary (gh attestation verify --owner rhysd) in our pinned base.

deps.name: ghcr.io/zizmorcore/zizmor:1.32.0
deps.purpose: Workflow security analysis (./seclab lint workflows).
deps.provenance: cosign keyless signature on each platform's BuildKit attestation manifest via docker/github-builder (workflow repository zizmorcore/zizmor, ref refs/tags/v1.32.0; issuer token.actions.githubusercontent.com).
deps.verify: ./seclab lint workflows -> verify_signed_image: build/verify-image.ts walks the pinned index by digest and binds every platform image to an attestation whose in-toto subject names it; cosign verifies each attestation's keyless signature (identity docker/github-builder build.yml, workflow repository zizmorcore/zizmor, ref refs/tags/v1.32.0, issuer GitHub Actions). Cached per digest under .work/deps-verified. Runs offline, --network none, no credentials.
deps.bump: Fork-build session; scheduled pin check; update the ref in seclab with the pin.

deps.name: ghcr.io/sigstore/cosign/cosign v3.0.3
deps.purpose: Verifies publisher signatures before use (verify_signed_image in seclab).
deps.provenance: Sigstore signs its releases; the image's signature was not found by cosign 2.4.1 or 3.0.3 in the formats they read (2026-11-04).
deps.verify: Digest pin from the project's own registry; runs with no credentials and no repo mount.
deps.gap: The verifier's own signature isn't verified yet; check its release bundle (gh attestation / cosign verify-blob on the release binary) and pin that.

deps.name: ghcr.io/gitleaks/gitleaks v8.30.1
deps.purpose: Pre-mount secret scan (a security control) and pre-push secret checks.
deps.provenance: None: no image or binary signature or attestation.
deps.verify: Digest pin; --network none, read-only source mount.
deps.gap: Gates a security control with no provenance. Proposed: build from the v8.30.1 tag (git, commit verified) in our attested CI and pin our image.

deps.name: actions/checkout v7.0.1
deps.purpose: Checkout in every workflow (persist-credentials: false).
deps.provenance: Commit SHA in GitHub's own repo; not an immutable release.
deps.verify: Full-SHA pin; repo setting sha_pinning_required; GitHub-owned actions only.

deps.name: actions/cache v6.1.0 (restore, save)
deps.purpose: Lychee and build caches (restore-only on PRs).
deps.provenance: Commit SHA in GitHub's own repo; not an immutable release.
deps.verify: Full-SHA pin; sha_pinning_required.

deps.name: actions/setup-node v7.1.0
deps.purpose: Node for the macOS build and Linux CI steps.
deps.provenance: Immutable release with a GitHub release attestation.
deps.verify: Full-SHA pin; sha_pinning_required.

deps.name: actions/upload-artifact v7.0.2
deps.purpose: Uploads the macOS build from main.
deps.provenance: Commit SHA in GitHub's own repo; not an immutable release.
deps.verify: Full-SHA pin; sha_pinning_required.

deps.name: actions/attest-build-provenance v4.2.2
deps.purpose: Attests the macOS build; ./seclab fetch macos verifies it.
deps.provenance: Immutable release with a GitHub release attestation.
deps.verify: Full-SHA pin; sha_pinning_required.

deps.name: Broker Python packages (runtime, test, integration harness and upstream images)
deps.publisher: Each package's own PyPI account (detail in the broker session's sub-register)
deps.purpose: Broker runtime on mitmproxy, and its tests.
deps.provenance: Hash-locked; PEP 740 attestations where the package publishes them (broker session: 25 of 43).
deps.verify: pip install --require-hashes --no-deps (broker/tools/pin_check.py enforces); pypi-attestations verify in a hash-locked verifier image where published.

deps.name: Debian packages in the Linux builder image
deps.purpose: Native toolchain and headers for the Code-OSS build.
deps.provenance: GPG-signed InRelease; per-package SHA-256 via Packages.
deps.verify: apt's default signature verification (debian-archive-keyring in the base image). Versions not pinned (ADR: live security updates over byte reproducibility).
deps.bump: Follows the base image and the archive.

deps.name: Debian packages in the OCI tab image
deps.purpose: Relay, git and process tools inside OCI tabs.
deps.provenance: GPG-signed InRelease; per-package SHA-256 via Packages.
deps.verify: apt's default signature verification. Versions not pinned (ADR).
deps.bump: Follows the base image and the archive.

deps.name: Debian packages in the broker integration test images
deps.purpose: Test workspace and upstream fixtures for the broker.
deps.provenance: GPG-signed InRelease; per-package SHA-256 via Packages.
deps.verify: apt's default signature verification.

deps.name: Docker Sandboxes (sbx) and its shell kit
deps.purpose: Primary tab runtime (one microVM per tab); the shell kit is the tab template base.
deps.provenance: Installed by the user; the shell kit (docker.io/sbx/shell, built from DHI's Debian 13 template) is chosen by the sbx version. Whether the kit is signed is unconfirmed.
deps.verify: None by us beyond the sbx version; the template we save is rebuilt from it plus our pinned REH.
deps.gap: Kit provenance unconfirmed; check sbx kit verify for Docker's own kits.

deps.name: Docker Desktop (macOS)
deps.purpose: Container runtime for builds, lints and OCI tabs.
deps.provenance: Developer-ID signed, Apple-notarized app.
deps.verify: macOS Gatekeeper at install.

deps.name: GitHub CLI (gh)
deps.purpose: Attestation verification (fetch macos, image provenance) and repo operations.
deps.provenance: Release binaries carry GitHub attestations; Homebrew bottle / signed apt repo / notarized pkg.
deps.verify: Installed by the user or preinstalled on Actions runners.
